Name: Simple Inventory Shipping
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]Simple Inventory Shipping[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][color=#9ACAF7]Your farm's shipping bin, within reach of your inventory.[/color][/size]
[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/size][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]📦 Ship from your inventory[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Open the farm shipping bin from an inventory button or a shortcut. Select items to ship using the normal shipping menu. Payment arrives overnight, and you can retrieve the last item shipped before settlement. No carryable bin or extra inventory slot is needed.[/size]

[center][url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54627/54627-1793023593-1318205663.png][img width=900]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54627/54627-1793023593-1318205663.png[/img][/url][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🎮 Controls and settings[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Open your inventory and select the shipping-bin button in the Simple shortcut column beside it.

[b]Keyboard:[/b] F8
[b]Controller:[/b] Click the right stick

These defaults can be changed in Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json. Existing configured shortcuts are retained when updating. Opening confirmation can be turned off in settings. If an inventory layout has no safe button space, use your configured shortcut.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#C8B0F4]🎒 Backpack and item protection[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52279]Simple Backpack Upgrade[/url] 1.7's expanded inventory and scrolling. Convenient Inventory's Quick Stack button and controller navigation stay available, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52969]Simple Item Lock[/url] continues to protect locked items from shipping. Normal shipping eligibility still applies.[/size]

[center][url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54627/54627-1793029185-1568608229.png][img width=900]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54627/54627-1793029185-1568608229.png[/img][/url][/center]
[size=4][i]Screenshots include additional UI mods; Inventory Shipping uses your current game interface.[/i][/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]⚙️ Installation[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4. Extract the SimpleInventoryShipping folder into your Mods folder and launch the game through SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

To remove the mod, delete its folder. Items already shipped remain in the game's normal shipping bin.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🌐 Languages[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]For a bug, please include the mod, game and SMAPI versions, your platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if it helps.

For an idea, tell me what you would like changed or added and how it would help you.[/size]
